scenes.title: Distinguish roster roles, staffing and status

captions.text: Personnel shows a member’s roles separately from staffing,
status, and administrative state.
In our fictional Chicago Fire department, Casey begins with Officer,
On Shift, Standing By, and Admin.
Choose Manage Roles to inspect the catalog.
The page lists each role’s description and member count.
It also explains how role order chooses an available custom
icon for a person’s map pin.
We will leave the original six roles and their order unchanged, and add one
clearly marked coordination exercise.
